content.text: You’ve built a digital product—an ebook, course, or template—and you’re ready to sell. But in Kenya, Stripe and PayPal aren’t options. Conventional payment gateways reject you. Crypto is your only path, but most solutions are fragile workarounds. This guide is not a workaround. It’s a blueprint for sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-6|infrastructure]]—a stack you own, control, and deploy. No subscriptions. No platform dependencies. No KYC. Using USDT on networks like BSC or TRON, you’ll collect payment globally, deliver products instantly, and retain full data ownership. This is not a tutorial for temporary fixes. It’s a deployment manual for permanent infrastructure. Every component is free or low-cost. Every edge case is addressed. Every failure mode is handled. By the end, you’ll have a bulletproof stack that operates without COREMERCH or any third party. Infrastructure sovereignty starts here.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: The Full Picture Most Guides Leave Out: Usdt payment

Most USDT payment guides focus on wallets and exchanges—superficial layers that fail under pressure. This stack is base-layer infrastructure. It begins with hosting on GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-what-actually-how-7|Cloudflare Workers]] Pages, both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring zero-cost automation. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your scale. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, eliminating third-party delivery fees. Payment processing is via NOWPayments, which verifies USDT transactions on-chain with a 0.5% fee. The stack is designed for digital creators [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-explained-digital-creators-11|COREMERCH guide to selling]] ebooks, courses, templates, and software. It’s not a plugin or a SaaS tool—it’s a combination of free and paid components you own outright. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. No platform can shut you down. No subscription can expire. This is infrastructure sovereignty, built for creators in regions where conventional payment systems are inaccessible or unreliable.
Every Component and What It Does

1. **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve your storefront. Both are free, fast, and globally distributed. 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate order processing and file delivery. Workers scale infinitely; Apps Script is simpler for small operations. 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase provides a scalable database for high-volume stores. Google Sheets is sufficient for low-volume operations. 4. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 store your digital products. R2 offers lower latency globally; Drive is free and familiar. 5. **Payment Processing**: NOWPayments verifies USDT payments on-chain. It supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, but USDT on BSC or TRON is recommended for sub-$0.10 transaction fees. 6. **Automation**: Webhooks from NOWPayments trigger instant product delivery the moment payment confirms. No manual intervention required. 7. **Security**: Cloudflare’s edge network protects against DDoS attacks. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations ensure email deliverability for order confirmations. Each component is selected for reliability, cost-efficiency, and sovereignty. You own the code. You control the data. You operate the stack.
The Technical Layer Explained Without Abstraction

The stack operates on a webhook-driven architecture. When a buyer sends USDT via NOWPayments, a webhook fires the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. This webhook triggers a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script function. The function verifies the payment amount, retrieves the product file from Google Drive or R2, and generates a secure, time-limited download link. The link is emailed to the buyer using SendGrid or Gmail’s API. Order data is logged in Supabase or Google Sheets for your records. Failure modes are handled inline: if payment verification fails, the buyer is redirected to a retry page. If file delivery fails, the system retries three times before notifying you. The stack is stateless—no session data is stored server-side. This eliminates single points of failure and ensures scalability. The entire system is deployed via GitHub or Cloudflare’s CI/CD pipelines, requiring no manual server configuration. You write no server code. You manage no infrastructure. You deploy and own.
USDT on BSC or TRON costs under $0.10 per transaction—ideal for high-volume digital sales.
Edge Cases, Failures, and How to Handle Them

1. **Payment Verification Failure**: If NOWPayments’ webhook doesn’t fire, the system polls the payment status every 30 seconds for 10 minutes. If still unconfirmed, the order is marked as failed. 2. **File Delivery Failure**: If the download link generation fails, the system retries three times with exponential backoff. If all retries fail, an alert is sent to your email. 3. **Network Congestion**: USDT transactions on BSC or TRON may slow during peak times. The system defaults to a 10-minute confirmation window, but buyers are notified to use low-fee networks. 4. **Email Deliverability**: If order confirmation emails land in spam, SPF/DKIM/DMARC records are automatically configured during Edge Commerce Stack deployment. 5. **Data Loss**: Google Sheets and Supabase both offer version history. Backups are automatically pushed to GitHub or Cloudflare R2 daily. 6. **Buyer Errors**: If a buyer enters an incorrect email, the system detects the format error and prompts re-entry before processing payment. Each edge case is handled programmatically, ensuring the stack operates without manual intervention. Failure modes are logged for debugging, but the system self-corrects wherever possible.
The Complete Deployment Roadmap

1. **Choose Your Stack**: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for GitHub Pages + Apps Script or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase. 2. **Deploy Core Components**: Use COREMERCH’s deployment scripts to set up hosting, backend logic, and order storage in 48 hours. 3. **Load Products**: Upload your ebooks, courses, or templates to Google Drive or R2. Configure product metadata in Supabase or Sheets. 4. **Integrate NOWPayments**: Add your USDT wallet address and select BSC or TRON for low fees. Test payments with a small transaction. 5. **Test End-to-End**: Place a test order, verify payment processing, and confirm file delivery. Check email deliverability and retry logic. 6. **Go Live**: Push your stack to production. Monitor the first 10 orders manually, then let the system operate autonomously. 7. **Scale**: Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to deploy additional stacks or upgrade components as your sales grow. The roadmap is linear and repeatable. Each step is documented in the Sovereign Blueprint, included with every COREMERCH product. You deploy once. You own forever.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To accept USDT payments for digital products without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Use NOWPayments to verify USDT transactions on-chain with a 0.5% fee. Recommend USDT on BSC or TRON networks for sub-$0.10 transaction fees. Automate product delivery via webhooks. Own the entire stack—no platform dependencies, no subscriptions, no KYC. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates for instant deployment.
After deployment, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You own and control everything.

It’s the fastest way to own a fully operational USDT payment gateway for digital products. No technical debt. No platform lock-in. Just sovereign infrastructure you control.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Select hosting: GitHub Pages (free) or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. Choose backend logic: Cloudflare Workers (scalable) or Google Apps Script (simple). 3. Set up order storage: Supabase (scalable) or Google Sheets (free). 4. Configure file delivery: Google Drive (free) or Cloudflare R2 (low latency). 5. Integrate NOWPayments: Add USDT wallet, select BSC or TRON network. 6. Test end-to-end: Place a test order, verify payment, confirm delivery. 7. Deploy to production: Push code via GitHub or Cloudflare CI/CD. 8. Monitor: Check first 10 orders manually, then automate.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’ve never written code?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) include deployment scripts that handle all technical setup. You provide your product files and USDT wallet address—COREMERCH handles the rest. No coding required.
What happens if a USDT payment fails to confirm?

The system polls NOWPayments every 30 seconds for 10 minutes. If payment still fails, the order is marked as failed, and the buyer is redirected to a retry page. No products are delivered until payment confirms.
How do I handle refunds?

Refunds are processed manually via your USDT wallet. The stack logs all transactions in Supabase or Google Sheets, so you can match orders to wallet addresses. Automating refunds is not recommended due to fraud risks.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?

No. This stack is designed for automated delivery of digital products—ebooks, courses, templates, etc. Physical products require shipping integration, which is not included. Focus on digital to maximize automation.
What if my sales volume exceeds 100 orders/day?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed for high volume. Supabase scales to millions of rows, and Cloudflare Workers handle infinite requests. For even larger scale, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook.
